dict.string: 開いているフォルダに新規ファイルを作成する / Create a new file in the open folder
開いているフォルダに新規ファイルを作成 / Create a new file in the open folder

use framework "Foundation" use scripting additions
on t(ja, en) set lang to system attribute "language" if lang is "ja" then return ja if lang is "en" then return en set preferred to (current application's NSLocale's preferredLanguages()'s firstObject()) as text if preferred is "ja" or preferred starts with "ja-" then return ja return en end t
on run argv set fileName to ((current application's NSString's stringWithString:(item 1 of argv))'s stringByTrimmingCharactersInSet:(current application's NSCharacterSet's whitespaceCharacterSet())) as text set nameIds to id of fileName if fileName is "" or nameIds is 46 or nameIds is {46, 46} or fileName contains "/" or fileName contains ":" or fileName contains (character id 10) or fileName contains (character id 13) then return my t("このファイル名は使えません（/、:、改行、「.」「..」は不可）: ", "Invalid file name (/, :, line breaks, \".\" and \"..\" are not allowed): ") & fileName set folderPath to POSIX path of (path to desktop folder) set pathFinder to "Path Finder" try tell application "System Events" to set frontApp to name of first process whose frontmost is true if frontApp is pathFinder then tell application pathFinder to set folderPath to «property pthP» of «property tarG» of «class fwiD» 1 else tell application "Finder" to set folderPath to POSIX path of (target of front Finder window as alias) end if on error errMsg number errNum if errNum is -1743 then return my t("オートメーションの許可が必要です。システム設定 > プライバシーとセキュリティ > オートメーション で Alfred に Finder・Path Finder・System Events の制御を許可してください。", "Automation access is required. Allow Alfred to control Finder, Path Finder and System Events in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation.") end try if folderPath does not end with "/" then set folderPath to folderPath & "/" set filePath to folderPath & fileName try do shell script "test ! -e " & quoted form of filePath & " && test ! -L " & quoted form of filePath on error return my t("同名の項目があるため作成しませんでした: ", "Not created because an item with the same name exists: ") & filePath end try try do shell script "set -o noclobber; : > " & quoted form of filePath on error errMsg return my t("作成できませんでした: ", "Could not create the file: ") & filePath & " (" & errMsg & ")" end try if (system attribute "open_after_create") is in {"1", "true"} then try do shell script "open " & quoted form of filePath on error return my t("作成しましたが、開けませんでした: ", "Created, but could not open: ") & filePath end try end if return my t("作成しました: ", "Created: ") & filePath end run

FinderまたはPath Finderで開いているフォルダに空のファイルを作成します。ウインドウがなければデスクトップに作成します。同名の項目があれば作成しません。 Creates an empty file in the folder open in Finder or Path Finder (the Desktop if no window is open). Existing items are never overwritten.
Usage: <keyword> file-name.txt (default keyword: nf)
Workflowが表示する文言の言語。 / Language of the text shown by the workflow.
Alfredで入力するキーワード。 / The keyword typed in Alfred.
作成したファイルを既定のアプリで開きます。 / Open the created file in its default app.
作成後に開く / Open after creating
